facts.claim: The Company’s troops made an assault and carried the stockade without difficulty or loss.
facts.quote: the Company’s troops made an assault and carried it without difficulty or loss

facts.claim: A reconnoitering party of 4 officers, 40 European and 80 Native Infantry was sent to ascertain the locality of a strong stockade.
facts.quote: A reconnoitering party, consisting of 4 officers, 40 European and 80 Native Infantry was sent to ascertain its locality

facts.claim: The party was attacked on the spot, losing 2 officers killed and wounded and more than half of the men, the greater proportion killed.
facts.quote: the party was attacked on the spot, when it had received orders to retire and it reached the camp 5 miles distant at Ishvaramangala with the loss of 2 officers killed and wounded and more than half of the men, the greater proportion killed
